title: Ghana mourns its tallest man - a 'generous and popular giant'
english: Sulemana Abdul Samed, widely known as Ghana's tallest man, has passed away at the age of 33 following complications from a leg infection. Standing at over seven feet tall due to gigantism caused by Marfan syndrome, he was a beloved figure and a local icon in his hometown of Gambaga. Despite receiving medical support for his condition, he died suddenly in a hospital in Tamale, leaving his community in deep mourning.
amharic: የጋና ረጅሙ ሰው በመባል የሚታወቀው ሱሌማና አብዱል ሳሜድ በእግር ኢንፌክሽን ህመም ምክንያት በ33 ዓመቱ ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ተለይቷል። ማርፋን ሲንድሮም በተባለ የጤና እክል ምክንያት ቁመቱ ከሰባት ጫማ በላይ የነበረው ሱሌማና፣ በትውልድ ከተማው ጋምባጋ ትልቅ ክብርና ፍቅር የነበረው ሰው ነበር። ለህመሙ የህክምና እርዳታ እየተደረገለት ቢሆንም በታማሌ ሆስፒታል ባጋጠመው ድንገተኛ ሞት መላው ማህበረሰቡ በሃዘን ተውጧል።
oromo: Namichi Ganaa keessatti dheeraa ture Sulemaanaa Abdul Saamed, umrii isaa waggaa 33tti dhukkuba miilla isaa irratti mudateen du'aan boqoteera. Dhukkuba 'Marfan syndrome' jedhamuun qabamee dheerinni isaa meetira lamaa fi seentimeetira 23 kan ga'u Sulemaanaa, magaalatti isaa Gambaagaatti nama baay'ee jaallatamuufi beekamu ture. Wal’ansa fayyaa argachaa tureyyuu, mana yaala magaalaa Taamaaleetti tasa du’uun isaa uummata biratti gadda guddaa uumeera.

title: Odyssey translator writes scathing review of Nolan film adaptation
english: Renowned translator Emily Wilson has published a harsh critique of Christopher Nolan's new film adaptation of The Odyssey. Although the movie is a commercial success, Wilson criticized the screenplay as shallow and lacking emotional depth. However, she expressed gratitude for the director's role in encouraging the public to read classic literature and bringing audiences back to theaters.
amharic: ታዋቂዋ ተርጓሚ ኤሚሊ ዊልሰን የክሪስቶፈር ኖላንን አዲስ የፊልም ስራ 'ኦዲሲ'ን በማጥላላት ጠንካራ ትችት ሰንዝረዋል። ፊልሙ በገበያ ላይ ስኬታማ ቢሆንም፣ ዊልሰን የስክሪፕቱን ጥራት መውደቅ እና የገጸ-ባህሪያቱን ጥልቀት ማጣት ተችተዋል። ሆኖም፣ ፊልሙ የጥንታዊ ስነ-ጽሁፍ መጽሃፍትን ተወዳጅነት በመጨመር ህዝብን ወደ ሲኒማ ቤት እንዲመለስ ማድረጉን አድንቀዋል።
oromo: Hayyuun hiikaa beekamaan Emilii Wiilson fiilmii haarawa Kristoofar Noolan kan 'Oodiiisii' jedhamu irratti qeeqa cimaa dhiheessiteetti. Fiilmichi gabaa irratti milkaa'ina guddaa gonfatee jiraatus, Wiilson barreffamni fiilmichaa gad-fageenyaafi miira kan hin qabne ta'uu isaa dubbatteetti. Ta'us, fiilmichi dubbifattoota gara barruuwwan durii deebisuufi namoonni gara sinimaatti akka deebi'an taasisuu isaa galata galchiteetti.

title: ‘The dream I carried is gone’: Miscarriages rise amid trauma of Gaza’s war
english: Doctors in Gaza report a significant increase in miscarriages, attributing nearly 70% of these pregnancy losses to the ongoing war, forced displacement, and severe lack of resources. Expectant mothers are suffering from extreme malnutrition, constant fear, and the collapse of medical services, making it nearly impossible to sustain healthy pregnancies. Many women, like Nuha Abu Lebda, have faced multiple heartbreaks after losing their babies due to these dire living conditions.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚገኙ ዶክተሮች የእርግዝና መቋረጥ መጠን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ መጨመሩን ገልጸው፣ ከእነዚህ ውስጥ ወደ 70 በመቶ የሚሆኑት ከጦርነቱ፣ ከማፈናቀል እና ከመድኃኒት እጦት ጋር የተያያዙ መሆናቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ነፍሰ ጡር እናቶች በከባድ የምግብ እጥረት፣ በስነ-ልቦና ጭንቀት እና የጤና አገልግሎት በመውደሙ ምክንያት ለከፍተኛ ስቃይ ተዳርገዋል። እንደ ኑሃ አቡ ለብዳ ያሉ ብዙ እናቶች አስቸጋሪ በሆነው የጦርነት ሁኔታ ምክንያት ህጻናቸውን እያጡ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Ogeeyyonni fayyaa Gaazaa keessatti baay'inni ulfa ba'uu dabalaa dhufuu isaa ibsanii, kana keessaa 70% kan ta'u waraana, buqqaatii fi hanqina tajaajila fayyaa wajjin kan walqabatu ta'uu ibsaniiru. Haadholiin ulfa ta'an dhabama nyaataa, sodaa fi manca'iinsa dhaabbilee fayyaa irraa kan ka'e rakkoo guddaa keessa jiru. Akka Nuhaa Abuu Lebdaa kanneen ta'an haadholiin hedduun haala waraanaa kanaan walqabatee ijoollee isaanii dhabuun gadda guddaa keessa jiru.

title: Malaysian foreign minister calls for review of UNHCR’s presence
english: Malaysia's foreign minister is calling for a potential reassessment of the UNHCR's role in the country due to concerns over how refugee documents are issued. The government wants tighter cooperation and stricter screening procedures to manage the influx of asylum seekers more effectively. This demand follows the recent detention of over 100 Rohingya refugees in Kuala Lumpur, highlighting growing tensions regarding the agency's current operations.
amharic: የማሌዢያ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር የተባበሩት መንግስታት የስደተኞች ኤጀንሲ (UNHCR) የስደተኞች ሰነዶችን በሚሰጥበት ሂደት ላይ ጥብቅ ቁጥጥር እንዲደረግ ጠይቀዋል። መንግስት የስደተኞችን ፍሰት ለመቆጣጠር ከኤጀንሲው ጋር በጋራ መስራት እንደሚፈልግ እና ይህም ካልሆነ ኤጀንሲው በሀገሪቱ ያለውን መገኘት እንደገና ማጤን እንደሚያስፈልግ ገልፀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የመጣው በኩዋላ ላምፑር ከ100 በላይ የሮሂንጋ ስደተኞች ከታሰሩ በኋላ ሲሆን፣ በኤጀንሲው አሰራር ላይ ያለው አለመግባባት እየተባባሰ መምጣቱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Ministirri dhimmi alaa Maleezhiyaa dhaabbanni baqattootaa tokkummaa mootummootaa (UNHCR) waajjira isaa keessatti eenyummaa baqattootaa kennuu irratti to’annoo cimaa akka godhu gaafataniiru. Mootummaan rakkoo baqattootaa sirnaan bulchuuf UNHCR wajjin waliin hojjechuu akka barbaadu fi akkaataa kanaan duratti hojjetamuun itti fufuu akka hin dandeenye ibseera. Murtii kana kan fidus baqattoota Rohinga 100 ol ta’an magaala Kuaalaalampuuritti erga qabamaniin booda, haala hojii UNHCR irratti mormiin guddaan ka’uun isaa ti.

title: ‘No freedom at all’: Israeli closures leave West Bank patients trapped
english: Following a large-scale military operation in the West Bank, Israeli forces have imposed tight closures and roadblocks that severely hinder medical access. Ambulance drivers are facing hours of delays at checkpoints, forcing them to take long detours and endangering patients who need urgent care. These restrictions are making it nearly impossible for people in critical condition to reach essential hospital services in cities like Nablus.
amharic: በምዕራብ ባንክ በተካሄደው መጠነ ሰፊ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ተከትሎ፣ የእስራኤል ኃይሎች የጣሉት ጥብቅ የጉዞ ገደብ እና ፍተሻዎች የሕክምና አገልግሎትን ክፉኛ አግደዋል። የአምቡላንስ አሽከርካሪዎች በኬላዎች ላይ ለረጅም ሰዓታት በመቆየታቸው ታማሚዎች ወደ ሆስፒታል ለመድረስ ረጅም መንገድ እንዲጓዙ እና ለአደጋ እንዲጋለጡ ተገደዋል። እነዚህ የጉዞ ገደቦች በተለይም በአስቸኳይ ህክምና የሚያስፈልጋቸው ሰዎች እንደ ናቡሉስ ባሉ ከተሞች የሚገኙ የጤና ተቋማትን እንዳያገኙ እያደረጋቸው ነው።
oromo: Humni Israa'eel naannoo Zoonii Lixaa keessatti duula waraanaa bal'aa gaggeesseen walqabatee, daandiiwwan cufuun tajaajila fayyaa irratti dhiibbaa cimaa uumee jira. Ogeeyyonni ambuulansii bakka sakatta'iinsaa irratti sa'aatii dheeraaf waan qabamaniif, dhukkubsattoota gara hospitaalaa geessuun ulfaataa ta'ee jira. Gochi kun dhukkubsattoonni xiyyeeffannoo ariifachiisaa barbaadan hospitaalota magaalaa Naabulus jiran akka hin geenye godhee, lubbuu isaanii balaaf saaxilaa jira.

title: Uganda declares end to Ebola outbreak
english: Ugandan health officials have officially declared the country free of Ebola after passing 42 days without any new infections. Although the outbreak is over, the government is advising citizens to stay vigilant because a severe epidemic continues to affect the neighboring Democratic Republic of the Congo. During the local outbreak, 20 cases were reported, resulting in two deaths.
amharic: የዩጋንዳ የጤና ባለስልጣናት በሀገሪቱ ምንም አይነት አዲስ የኢቦላ በሽታ ወረርሽኝ ሳይከሰት 42 ቀናት በመቆጠሩ፣ ሀገሪቱ ከኢቦላ ነፃ መሆኗን በይፋ አውጀዋል። ወረርሽኙ ቢቆምም መንግስት አጎራባች በሆነችው ኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ የኢቦላ ስርጭት እየተባባሰ በመሆኑ ህዝቡ ጥንቃቄ እንዲያደርግ አሳስቧል። በዩጋንዳ በተከሰተው በዚህ ወረርሽኝ 20 ሰዎች በቫይረሱ የተያዙ ሲሆን ሁለት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni fayyaa Yugaandaa guyyoota 42f vaayirasichi erga mul’achuu dhaabatee booda, biyyattii vaayirasii Ibolaa irraa bilisa ta’uu isaanii labsaniiru. Gabaasichi kan xumurame ta’us, biyya ollaa Kongootti vaayirasichi daran babal’achaa waan jiruuf mootummaan ummanni akka of eeggannoo godhu gorseera. Yugaandaa keessatti namoonni 20 vaayirasichaan qabamanii, isaan keessaa lama lubbuun darbeera.

title: Lindsey Graham ‘almost cried’ tears of joy over war on Iran, footage shows
english: Recently released documentary footage reveals that the late Senator Lindsey Graham took personal credit for convincing Donald Trump to initiate a war against Iran alongside Israel. In the recording, Graham expressed immense joy over the military campaign, noting that he nearly shed tears of happiness when it began. The senator also revealed that he encouraged Trump to support further military actions in Lebanon while acting as a bridge between the American president and Benjamin Netanyahu.
amharic: በቅርቡ ይፋ የሆነ የቪዲዮ መረጃ እንደሚያሳየው፣ አሁን በህይወት የሌሉት ሴናተር ሊንድሴ ግርሃም፣ ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከእስራኤል ጋር በመሆን በኢራን ላይ ጦርነት እንዲያውጁ ለማሳመን የራሳቸውን ሚና እንደተጫወቱ ተናግረዋል። ግርሃም ጦርነቱ ሲጀመር በደስታ እንባ እስኪቃርባቸው ድረስ እንደተሰማቸው በቪዲዮው ላይ ገልጸዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ በፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ እና በእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ መካከል የነበሩትን ግንኙነቶች በማቀናጀት ትራምፕ በሊባኖስ ላይም ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እንዲወስዱ ይገፋፉ እንደነበር ተጋልጧል።
oromo: Suurri fi sagaleen suuraa haaraa bahe akka agarsiisutti, seenaatara duraanii kan turan Liindsee Giraaham, doonald tiraampii fi Israa'el waraana Iraan irratti akka banan gochuuf ofiisaanii akka gumaachan dubbataniiru. Giraaham waraanni kun yeroo jalqabame gammachuu guddaa itti dhaga'amee, imimmaannii gammachuu akka isaan qabates qaxxaamuraan ibsaniiru. Dabalataanis, seenaatarichi tiraampii fi banyaamiin Netaanyaahuu gidduutti ta'uun, tiraampiin biyya Liibaanoos irrattis tarkaanfii waraanaa akka fudhatan jajjabeessaa akka turan ifa ta'eera.

title: Senior source says Trump, Netanyahu discussed ensuring Iran never possessed nuclear weapons
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and US President Donald Trump held a highly productive meeting in Washington. During their discussion, both leaders focused on major regional topics, with a primary emphasis on the Iranian nuclear threat. They both pledged to work together to guarantee that Iran is prevented from ever acquiring nuclear weapons.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ እና የአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በዋሽንግተን ተገናኝተው ገንቢ ውይይት አድርገዋል። መሪዎቹ በወቅታዊ ጉዳዮች ላይ በስፋት የተወያዩ ሲሆን፣ ዋና ትኩረታቸውም የኢራን የኒውክሌር ፕሮግራም ነበር። ኢራን የኒውክሌር መሳሪያ እንዳታገኝ ለመከላከል በጋራ ለመስራት ቃል ገብተዋል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeera Israa'el Benyaamin Netaaniyaahunii fi Preezidaantiin Ameerikaa Doolard Tiraamp Waashingitanitti wal arguun marii bu'aa qabeessa ta'e taasisaniiru. Hogganoonni lamaan dhimmoota yeroo irratti bal'inaan kan mari'atan yoo ta'u, xiyyeeffannoon isaanii inni guddaan rakkoo niwukilara Iiraan ture. Iiraan meeshaa niwukilaraa akka hin arganne ittisuuf waliin hojjechuuf waadaa galaniiru.

title: Qatar condemns renewed attacks on Jordan
english: Qatar has officially denounced the recent Iranian strikes against Jordan, describing the military action as a serious threat to stability in the region. The Qatari government labeled these attacks a violation of international law and Jordanian sovereignty. Officials in Doha have urged an immediate end to all military hostilities to prevent further escalation.
amharic: ኳታር በዮርዳኖስ ላይ የተፈጸመውን የኢራን ጥቃት አውግዛለች፤ ጥቃቱ የክልሉን ሰላም ለአደጋ የሚጋብዝ አደገኛ ድርጊት መሆኑን ገልጻለች። የኳታር መንግስት ድርጊቱ የአለም አቀፍ ህግን እና የዮርዳኖስን ሉዓላዊነት የሚጥስ መሆኑን አስታውቋል። ሁኔታው እንዳይባባስም ሁሉም ወገኖች ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎችን እንዲያቆሙ ጥሪ አቅርቧል።
oromo: Qatar hujii waraanaa dhiyeenya kana gara Yordaanositti taasifame kan balaaleffatte yoo ta'u, gochi kun tasgabbii naannichaa miidhuu danda'a jetteetti. Mootummaan Qatar qaqqabiin kun seera idil-addunyaa fi mirga abbaa biyyummaa Yordaanos kan sarbu ta'uu ibseera. Akkasumas, rakkinichi akka hin hammaanneef gareewwan marti waraana akka dhaaban gaafateera.

title: Anger rises as ICC member states accused of facilitating Netanyahu’s flight to Washington
english: Critics are calling out several nations for allowing Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to fly through their airspace during his recent trip to Washington. These countries, including Greece, Italy, France, and Canada, are members of the International Criminal Court, which issued an arrest warrant for Netanyahu in 2024 regarding alleged war crimes in Gaza. Observers argue that these governments failed to fulfill their legal obligations by not obstructing the travel of a wanted individual.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ በቅርቡ ወደ ዋሽንግተን ባደረጉት ጉዞ የአለም አቀፍ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት አባል የሆኑ ሀገራት የአየር ክልላቸውን እንዲጠቀሙ መፍቀዳቸው ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ አስነስቷል። ግሪክ፣ ጣሊያን፣ ፈረንሳይ እና ካናዳ በ2024 በኔታንያሁ ላይ በጋዛ የጦር ወንጀል ፈጽመዋል በሚል የእስር ማዘዣ ያወጣውን ፍርድ ቤት ህግ የመከተል ግዴታ አለባቸው። ተቺዎች እነዚህ መንግስታት የተፈለገ ግለሰብን ለመያዝ ወይም ለመከልከል ያላቸውን አለም አቀፍ ግዴታ በመጣስ ተባባሪ ሆነዋል ሲሉ ይወቅሳሉ።
oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaahu yeroo gara Waashingitan imalanitti, biyyoonni miseensa Mana Murtii Yakka Addunyaa (ICC) ta'an qilleensa isaanii akka fayyadamu hayyamuun isaanii mormii cimaa kaasera. Biyyoonni kunniin, kanneen akka Girees, Xaaliyaanii, Faransaay fi Kaanaadaa, mana murtichaa kan bara 2024 Netanyaahu irratti yakka waraanaa fi namoomaa irratti raawwatamaniin murtee hidhaa dabarse kabajuuf dirqama qabu. Qeeqtonni mootummoonni kunniin nama barbaadamaa jiru tokko ittisuu dhiisuun, dirqama seeraa idil-addunyaa isaanii akka hin ba'in dubbatu.

title: Iran has ‘no plans’ to negotiate with US, deputy foreign minister says
english: Iran's deputy foreign minister has officially stated that the country has no intention of entering into negotiations with the United States. He criticized Washington for trying to dictate the terms of engagement and insisted that Iran would not allow the U.S. to choose when to fight or talk. Meanwhile, Iran is continuing separate, incremental discussions with Oman regarding the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.
amharic: የኢራን ምክትል የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ከአሜሪካ ጋር ለመደራደር ምንም ዓይነት እቅድ እንደሌላቸው በግልጽ ተናገሩ። ዋሽንግተን በፈለገችው ጊዜ ጦርነት እየከፈተች በፈለገችው ጊዜ ወደ ድርድር ጠረጴዛ መምጣት እንደሌለባትም ገልጸዋል። ከዚህ ውጪ፣ ኢራን የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤን መልሶ ለመክፈት ከኦማን ጋር በሂደት ላይ ያሉ ንግግሮች እንዳሏት አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Itti aantuun ministira dhimma alaa Iraan, biyyi isaanii Ameerikaa waliin marii gochuuf karoora akka hin qabne ibsaniiru. Washington yeroo feetetti waraana bantee yeroo feetetti ammoo marii gochuuf yaaluun ishee dogoggora ta'uu himaniiru. Ta'us, Iraan karaa biyya Omaan immoo dhimma daandii galaana Hormuz banuu ilaalchisee marii gaggeessaa jirti.

title: Iran backs Volker Turk reappointment to UN rights chief
english: Iran has officially expressed its support for Volker Turk to serve a second term as the UN human rights chief. This endorsement comes despite notable opposition from the United States, Israel, and Russia. Tehran praised Turk for his commitment to addressing serious international crimes, highlighting his focus on conflicts in Gaza and Ukraine.
amharic: ኢራን ቮልከር ቱርክ በተባበሩት መንግስታት የሰብአዊ መብቶች ከፍተኛ ኮሚሽነርነት ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ እንዲመረጡ ድጋፏን ሰጥታለች። ይህ ድጋፍ የተሰጠው አሜሪካ፣ እስራኤል እና ሩሲያ ቱርክን በመቃወም ላይ ባሉበት ወቅት ነው። ኢራን፣ ኮሚሽነሩ በጋዛ እና በዩክሬን እየተፈጸሙ ያሉ አለም አቀፍ ወንጀሎችን በመቃወም ረገድ ላሳዩት ቁርጠኝነት አድናቆቷን ገልጻለች።
oromo: Iiraan ቮልከር ቱርk itti gaafatamaa mirga namoomaa kan gamtaa mootummootaa ta'anii yeroo lammaffaaf akka filaman deeggarsa ishee ibsiteetti. Deeggarsi kun kan kenname biyyoonni akka Ameerikaa, Israa'el fi Raashiyaan mormaa jiranittuu dha. Iiraan ቱርk waraana Gaazaa fi yeroon Raashiyaan Yukreen weerarte irratti yakka raawwatame balaaleffachuu isaaniin akka deeggartu ibsiteetti.

title: Mysterious deaths of 14 elephants in Kenya prompts urgent inquiry
english: Kenyan wildlife authorities have launched an investigation into the sudden deaths of 14 elephants found near Amboseli National Park. Experts are currently analyzing tissue samples from the animals to determine if the cause is disease, poisoning, or another factor. Because the victims include elephants of various ages and sexes across different locations, officials are treating the situation as a serious and unusual event.
amharic: የኬንያ የዱር እንስሳት ጥበቃ ባለስልጣናት በአምቦሴሊ ብሔራዊ ፓርክ አቅራቢያ በድንገት የሞቱ 14 ዝሆኖችን አስመልክቶ ምርመራ ጀምረዋል። ባለሙያዎች የሞቱትን እንስሳት የሕክምና ናሙና በመውሰድ ሞታቸው በበሽታ፣ በመርዝ ወይም በሌላ ምክንያት መሆኑን ለማወቅ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። ዝሆኖቹ በተለያዩ ዕድሜና ጾታ የተከፋፈሉ እና በተለያዩ ቦታዎች የተገኙ በመሆናቸው፣ ጉዳዩን አሳሳቢ እና ያልተለመደ ክስተት አድርገው እየተመለከቱት ነው።
oromo: Abbootiin taayitaa bineensota bosonaa Keeniyaa, naannoo Paarkii Biyyoolessa Amboselitti argannee ijoollee arba 14 tasa du'an ilaalchisee qorannoo eegalaniiru. Ogeeyyonni foon fi qaama arboota du'anii fudhachuun duuti kun dhukkuba, summii ykn sababa biraatiin akka ta'e adda baasuuf tattaaffachaa jiru. Arboonni du'an kun umrii fi koorniyaa garaa garaa kan qaban fi bakka garaa garaatti kan argaman waan ta'eef, aangotni dhimma kana akka waan cimaa fi idilee hin taane tokkootti ilaalaa jiru.

title: Inside the secret battle to document RSF abuses in Sudan
english: A covert network of human rights monitors is risking their lives to record atrocities committed by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) in Sudan's Darfur region. Using secure communication and mobile devices, these teams are gathering evidence of systematic violence, mass executions, and widespread sexual abuse. Their primary goal is to preserve this documentation to ensure that victims can eventually seek justice for these grave crimes.
amharic: በሱዳን የዳርፉር ክልል በሚንቀሳቀሱ የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች፣ በራፒድ ሳፖርት ፎርሰስ (RSF) የሚፈጸሙ አሰቃቂ ጥቃቶችን በድብቅ የመመዝገብ ስራ እየተከናወነ ነው። እነዚህ ቡድኖች በከፍተኛ አደጋ ውስጥ ሆነው፣ ስልታዊ ግድያዎችን እና የጾታዊ ጥቃቶችን ማስረጃዎች በመሰብሰብ ላይ ይገኛሉ። የዚህ ጥረት ዋና አላማ ለወደፊት ተጎጂዎች ፍትህ እንዲገኝ ማስረጃዎችን በስርዓት ማቆየት ነው።
oromo: Godina Daarfuur kan Sudaan keessatti gareen mirga namoomaa iccitiidhaan socho'an humni 'Rapid Support Forces' (RSF) yakka raawwatu ragaa qabachaa jiru. Gareen kun balaa cimaa keessa ta'anii ajjeechaa sanyiin qindaa'eefi miidhaa saalqunnamtii irratti raawwatamu galmeessaa jiru. Kaayyoon isaanii inni guddaan ragaa kana kuusuudhaan yeroo gara fuulduraatti miidhamtootni akka haqaa argatan gochuudha.

title: New Party: Why Turkiye’s opposition suffered a split and what that means
english: Former CHP leader Ozgur Ozel has launched a new political party alongside 90 lawmakers after a court ruling annulled his previous leadership. This split follows a period of legal pressure and investigations into opposition-led municipalities that have resulted in the detention of key figures like Istanbul's mayor. Ozel intends for this new movement to serve as a fresh alternative to challenge President Erdogan's long-standing AK Party.
amharic: የቀድሞው የCHP መሪ ኦዝጉር ኦዘል እና 90 የፓርላማ አባላት በአዲሱ የፍርድ ቤት ውሳኔ አመራራቸው ከተሻረ በኋላ አዲስ የፖለቲካ ፓርቲ መስርተዋል። ይህ መከፋፈል የተፈጠረው በአንጃው ላይ በደረሰው የህግ ጫና እና በከተማ አስተዳዳሪዎች ላይ በተከፈተው ምርመራ ምክንያት ነው። ኦዘል ይህ አዲስ ንቅናቄ የፕሬዚዳንት ኤርዶጋንን የAK ፓርቲ ለመቃወም የሚያስችል አማራጭ እንደሚሆን ተስፋ አድርገዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni duraanii CHP kan ta'an Ozgur Ozel fi miseensonni mana maree 90 ta'an, murtee mana murtii booda paartii siyaasaa haaraa hundeesseera. Gargar bahuun kun kan dhufe dhiibbaa seeraa fi qorannoo bulchiinsa mormituu irratti gaggeeffamaa jiruun walqabatee dha. Ozel paartiin haaraan kun filannoo kakuu kanaan duraan turee fi paartii Prezidaant Erdogaan akkasumas AK Party dura dhaabbachuuf carraa haaraa ta'a jedhee amana.

title: Tributes paid to Lindsey Graham at US Capitol ceremony
english: A memorial service was held at the United States Capitol to honor the late Republican Senator Lindsey Graham. Many officials and political leaders gathered in the Capitol Rotunda to pay their respects to his legacy. The ceremony featured a military honor guard carrying his casket to acknowledge his previous service in the armed forces.
amharic: የቀድሞው የሪፐብሊካን ሴናተር ሊንዚ ግራሃም ህልፈትን ምክንያት በማድረግ በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ካፒቶል የተከበረ የመታሰቢያ ስነ-ስርዓት ተካሄዷል። በርካታ የመንግስት ባለስልጣናት እና የፖለቲካ መሪዎች በካፒቶል ህንፃ በመገኘት ለሴናተሩ ያላቸውን ክብር ገልጸዋል። የጦር ሃይል አባላት የሴናተሩን የውትድርና አገልግሎት ለማሰብ የሬሳ ሳጥኑን በክብር ተሸክመው ወደ ስፍራው አድርሰዋል።
oromo: Senatorii Ripabiliikaa kan turan Lindsey Graham yeroo boqotan sababeeffachuun, magaalaa Waashingitanitti sirni kabajaa kabajameef jira. Hoggantoonni fi qondaalonni mootummaa hedduun mana maree Kaapitolitti argamuun gumaacha inni biyya isaatiif godhe yaadatanii jiru. Sirnicharratti gareen waraanaa gumaacha inni yeroo tajaajila waraanaa godhe kabajuuf, reeffa isaa kabajaan baasuun sirnicha gaggeessaniiru.

title: War on Iran: Phase II: Day 17
english: On the 17th day of the second phase of the conflict, President Donald Trump claims that negotiations with Iran have resumed and suggests that Tehran is eager for an agreement. Conversely, Iranian officials confirm that discussions are happening but maintain that they are not in a hurry to finalize a deal. Tensions remain high as Iran has also rejected a US proposal regarding frozen funds and issued warnings concerning navigation in the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Ukraine’s Zelenskyy hails ‘good meeting’ with Trump at White House
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and US President Donald Trump held a productive meeting at the White House to discuss strengthening bilateral defense cooperation. The two leaders focused on plans for the joint production of Patriot missiles within Ukraine to improve the country's anti-aircraft defenses. Additionally, they reviewed diplomatic strategies aimed at ending the ongoing war and enhancing military technology partnerships.

oromo: Pireezidaantiin Yukireen Volodimiir Zeleniskii fi Pireezidaantiin Amerikaa Donaald Tiraamp waajjira adii keessatti marii bu'a qabeessa ta'e gaggeessaniiru. Hoggantoonni lamaan kun humna ittisa qilleensa biyyattii cimsuuf jecha biyyattii keessatti misaa'ela Paatriiyoooti waliin oomishuuf karoorfatan irratti xiyyeeffataniiru. Kana malees, waraana itti fufee jiru xumuruuf tooftaa dippiloomaasii fi guddina teknoolojii waraanaa irratti mari'ataniiru.

title: Uefa reacts with fury to Infantino World Cup plan
english: UEFA has expressed strong opposition to FIFA's plan to seek private investment for its tournaments, including the World Cup. FIFA argues that this funding will help grow the game globally, but critics worry it could lead to personal financial gain for president Gianni Infantino. European football officials have criticized the move, stating that the World Cup is a public asset that should not be sold to private interests.

oromo: UEFA hoggansi kubbaa miilaa Awurooppaa, FIFA dorgommiiwwan isaa keessumaa Waancaa Addunyaaf qabeenya dhuunfaa irraa maallaqa argachuuf karoorfate mormuun isaa beekameera. title: Is Netanyahu’s Trump card losing its power in Israel?
english: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is facing questions about his once-strong political alliance with Donald Trump as their relationship shows signs of strain. The ongoing war with Iran has stalled, and Washington is increasingly willing to negotiate regional deals without prioritizing Israel's interests. With elections approaching in October, Netanyahu is visiting Washington to restore his image and prove he still maintains vital influence over the U.S. government.

title: Iran rejects Trump frozen funds plan, warns ships of Hormuz transit ban
english: Iran has officially dismissed Donald Trump's proposal to use frozen Iranian assets to pay for ships damaged in the Gulf. An official from the Revolutionary Guard cautioned that any vessel attempting to collect these funds will be prohibited from passing through the Strait of Hormuz. This stance creates further tension regarding the control of this vital maritime shipping lane.

title: Trump expresses frustration with Netanyahu before White House meeting
english: President Trump expressed irritation toward Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu shortly before their White House meeting, criticizing him for publicly discussing sensitive intelligence regarding Iran. Trump dismissed the claims about Iran's nuclear site and suggested the Prime Minister is trying to pressure him into maintaining military involvement. This tension follows their joint participation in a conflict with Iran and differing views on diplomatic efforts to resolve the situation.

title: German investigators find apparent motive after Berlin Pride attack
english: German authorities have linked a deadly attack at a Berlin Pride event to the ISIL extremist group after discovering a video of the suspect pledging allegiance to the organization. The 21-year-old attacker, who was shot by police after killing one woman and injuring many others, had a prior history of legal trouble related to extremist activities. Investigators recovered evidence on the suspect's phone and at his residence confirming his radical connections.

title: FIFA World Cup: For India, qualification is still just a distant dream
english: India remains far from participating in the FIFA World Cup due to systemic failures, poor youth development, and organizational instability within its football federation. Despite its large population, the country is ranked 138th globally and recently failed to qualify for the 2027 Asian Cup. Experts suggest that reforming the sport will require decades of work to overcome these deep-seated structural challenges.
amharic: በህንድ እግር ኳስ ማህበር ውስጥ ባሉ የአደረጃጀት ችግሮች፣ ደካማ የወጣቶች ስፖርት ልማት እና የስርዓት መዛባት ምክንያት ህንድ በፊፋ የዓለም ዋንጫ ለመሳተፍ አሁንም በጣም የራቀች ናት። ምንም እንኳን ህንድ እጅግ ሰፊ ህዝብ ቢኖራትም፣ በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ በ138ኛ ደረጃ ላይ የምትገኝ ሲሆን በቅርቡም ለ2027 የእስያ ዋንጫ ማለፍ ተስኗታል። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት የሀገሪቱን እግር ኳስ ወደ ተሻለ ደረጃ ለማድረስ እና መሰረታዊ ችግሮችን ለመፍታት የበርካታ አስርት ዓመታት ስራ ያስፈልጋል።
oromo: Indiyaan rakkoo sirnaa, misooma dargaggootaa dadhabaa fi giddugaleessa kubbaa miillaa ishee keessatti rakkoo jiru irraa kan ka'e, hirmaannaa Waancaa Addunyaa FIFA irratti argachuun ishee ammallee kan fagaate dha. Biyyattii uummata baay'ee qabdu ta'us, sadarkaa addunyaatti 138ffaa irratti kan argamtu yoo ta'u, dhiheenya kana Waancaa Eeshiyaa bara 2027 qulqullaa'uun ishee dadhabameera. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, kubbaa miillaa biyyattii fooyyessuufi rakkoolee gadi fagoofii jiran kana furuuf waggoota hedduu kan fudhatu carraaqqii cimaa barbaada.

title: Exclusive: Does the UK's 'don't talk to the Muslim Council of Britain' policy actually exist?
english: The British government continues to avoid working with the Muslim Council of Britain (MCB), claiming it follows a long-standing non-engagement policy. However, investigative analysis suggests this policy may not officially exist, as government departments have no written documentation or clear justification for the boycott. This confusion arises as the government aims to repair its relationship with the Muslim community amid increasing reports of attacks on mosques.
amharic: የብሪታንያ መንግስት ከብሪታንያ ሙስሊሞች ምክር ቤት (MCB) ጋር ላለመስራት የቀድሞ መንግስታት የነበራቸውን ፖሊሲ እንደተከተለ ይገልጻል። ነገር ግን፣ ይህንን መመሪያ የሚያረጋግጥ ምንም አይነት የተፃፈ ሰነድ ወይም በቂ ምክንያት ባለመገኘቱ ፖሊሲው ምናልባትም በይፋ ያልነበረ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ጥናቶች ያሳያሉ። በሙስሊም ማህበረሰብ ላይ የሚደርሱ ጥቃቶች እየጨመሩ ባለበት ወቅት፣ መንግስት ከሙስሊም ማህበረሰብ ጋር ያለውን ግንኙነት ለማሻሻል እየሞከረ መሆኑም ተጠቁሟል።
oromo: Mootummaan Biritishii akkaataa heera mootummoota darban hordofuun mana maree Muslimoota Biritishii (MCB) wajjin hojjechuu akka hin barbaanne ibseera. Haa ta'u malee, qorannoon akka agarsiisutti, seera ykn qajeelfama kana kan mirkaneessu ragaan barreeffamaa tokkollee hin jiru. Yeroo ammaa, miidhaan masjiidota irratti qaqqabu dabalaa waan jiruuf, mootummaan ummata Muslimaa wajjin hariiroo isaa fooyyessuuf yaalaa jira.

title: Israeli forces demolish eleven homes in occupied West Bank during past 24 hours
english: Israeli forces recently destroyed eleven Palestinian homes in the occupied West Bank within a single day. Beyond the demolitions, authorities seized land for military use and began expanding settlement infrastructure near Tubas. Additionally, reports indicate that settlers attacked local residents while security forces carried out multiple arrests.
amharic: የእስራኤል ኃይሎች ባለፉት ሃያ አራት ሰዓታት ውስጥ በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ አስራ አንድ የፍልስጤም ቤቶችን አፍርሰዋል። ከዚህ ድርጊት በተጨማሪ ባለስልጣናቱ ለወታደራዊ አገልግሎት የሚውል መሬትን በቁጥጥራቸው ስር አውለዋል እንዲሁም አዳዲስ ሰፈራዎችን ለማስፋፋት የሚያስችሉ ተግባራትን ጀምረዋል። በሌላ በኩል ደግሞ በአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸሙና በርካታ ሰዎች መታሰራቸው ተዘግቧል።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el guyyoota darban keessa lafa daangaa dhihaa keessatti manneen warra Falastiinii kudha tokko diiganiiru. Diiggaa manneenii kana cinatti, mootummaan lafa qonnaan bultootaa waraanaf fayyadamuuf kan fudhate yoo ta'u, babal'ina bu'uuraalee misoomaa naannoo Tubasitti jalqabeera. Kana malees, qe'ee isaanii irratti namoota irratti haleellaan raawwatamuu fi namoonni hedduun hidhamuun gabaasameera.

title: Exclusive: Does the UK's 'don't talk to the Muslim Council of Britain' policy actually exist?
english: The new UK government under Andy Burnham claims to maintain a policy of not engaging with the Muslim Council of Britain (MCB). However, investigations reveal that there are no official written records or clear departmental origins for this boycott. Despite the government's stance, the lack of transparency raises questions about whether this policy exists in any formal capacity.
amharic: የእንግሊዝ አዲሱ መንግስት ከአንዲ በርንሃም መሪነት ጋር በብሪታንያ ሙስሊም ካውንስል (MCB) ላይ ያለው የግንኙነት እገዳ አሁንም እንደቀጠለ መሆኑን ገልጿል። ይሁን እንጂ የተደረጉ ምርመራዎች እንደሚያሳዩት ይህ እገዳ በጽሁፍ የተመዘገበ ህጋዊ ሰነድ የለውም። መንግስት ይህንን ፖሊሲ ተግባራዊ እያደረገ ቢሆንም፣ በይፋ የሚታወቅ የመንግስት ሰነድ ባለመገኘቱ ጉዳዩ ግራ አጋቢ ሆኗል።
oromo: Mootummaan UK kan haaraan Andy Burnham geggeeffamu, waldaan Muslimoota Britaan (MCB) waliin hidhata akka hin qabanne ibseera. Haa ta'u malee, qorannoon akka agarsiisutti, seera ykn qajeelfama gotee kana mirkaneessu kan barreeffamee taa'e hin jiru. Mootummaan dhorkaa kana itti fufuun isaa himamees, ragaan seera qabeessa ta'e tokkollee waan hin jirreef, dhimmichi shakkiin akka itti uumame ta'eera.

title: At least 22 Palestinians wounded in Israeli attacks on Gaza
english: Israeli military operations across the Gaza Strip on Tuesday resulted in at least 22 injuries among the local population. Attacks targeted various locations, including a school, a market in a refugee camp, and residential areas. Medical organizations and local sources confirmed that these incidents occurred in several different neighborhoods throughout the region.
amharic: ማክሰኞ ዕለት በእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ጥቃቶች የጋዛ ሰርጥ ውስጥ ቢያንስ 22 ሰዎች ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቶቹ ትምህርት ቤትን፣ የስደተኞች ካምፕ ገበያን እና የተለያዩ የመኖሪያ አካባቢዎችን ያነጣጠሩ ነበሩ። የህክምና ተቋማት እና የአካባቢው ምንጮች እንደገለጹት ጉዳቶቹ በተለያዩ የጋዛ ክፍሎች የተከሰቱ ናቸው።
oromo: Guyyaa Kibxataa weerara waraana Israa'el kan Gaazaa keessatti gaggeeffameen namoonni 22 ol ta'an miidhamaniiru. Weerara kana keessatti manneen barnootaa, gabaa keessatti bakka godaantonni qubatanii jiran, fi naannolee jireenyaa kanneen biroo rukutamaniiru. Maddoonni oduu fi dhaabbileen fayyaa akka gabaasanitti, miidhaan kun naannolee adda addaa Gaazaa keessatti kan qaqqabe ta'uu ibsameera.

title: Netanyahu arrives at the White House
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has reached the White House to hold private discussions with President Donald Trump. This encounter marks their first formal meeting since the start of the ongoing military conflict between Israel and Iran on February 28. The two leaders are expected to coordinate their strategies regarding the situation.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ከአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ጋር በዋይት ሀውስ በግል ለመነጋገር ተገናኝተዋል። ይህ ስብሰባ በእስራኤል እና በኢራን መካከል የካቲት 28 ከተጀመረው ግጭት በኋላ የሁለቱ መሪዎች የመጀመሪያ ግንኙነት ነው። መሪዎቹ በወቅታዊ ጉዳዮች ዙሪያ ምክክር እንደሚያደርጉ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Ministirri Muummee Israa'el Benyaamiin Neetanyaahuu pirezidaantii Ameerikaa Doolaard Tiraamp waliin marii dhimmoota iddoo cufaa ta'e irratti hirmaachuuf gara Waayit Haawus gahuun isaanii himameera. Kunis, waraanni Israa'el fi Iraan gidduutti Guraandhalaa 28 eegale erga jalqabee booda mariin gaggeeffamu isa jalqabaati. Hoggantoonni lamaan haala jiru irratti marii akka taasisan eegama.

title: Gironde wildfires pick up as French region braces for new 40C heatwave
english: Firefighters in France are struggling to contain intense wildfires in the Gironde region as they prepare for another severe heatwave with temperatures reaching 40C. While the city of Bordeaux is not immediately threatened, officials remain concerned about the fire's proximity and the resulting poor air quality. Residents and tourists are experiencing smoky conditions and significant disruptions to daily life as emergency teams work around the clock to manage the crisis.
amharic: በፈረንሳይ የጂሮንድ ክልል የተከሰተው ከፍተኛ የእሳት ቃጠሎ ባለመቆጣጠሩ የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች አዳጋች ሁኔታ ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። የሙቀት መጠኑ ወደ 40 ዲግሪ ሴልሺየስ የሚደርስ ሌላ የሙቀት ማዕበል በመምጣቱ ሁኔታውን የበለጠ አስቸጋሪ አድርጎታል። የቦርዶ ከተማ ነዋሪዎች እና ጎብኚዎች በጢስ እና በአመድ የተበከለ አየር እየተቸገሩ ሲሆን፣ የከተማዋ እንቅስቃሴም ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሶበታል።
oromo: Naannoo Jiirondii kan Faransaay keessatti ibidda cimaa ka'e to'achuuf gargaartonni ibiddaa halkanii fi guyyaa carraaqaa jiru, garuu qilleensi baay'ee ho'uun hanga 40C gahuuf jedhu haalicha caalaatti ulfeessaa jira. Magaalaan Boordoo battalumatti balaa keessa kan hin jirre ta'us, aaraan faalamee jiraachuu isaatiin jiraattonni fi turistoonni rakkoo hamaa keessa jiru. Gareen gargaarsa hatattamaa ibidda kana dhaamsuuf hamma danda'ametti carraaqqii cimaa gochaa jiru.

title: Mancini reappointed Italy boss after Pirlo controversy
english: Roberto Mancini has returned as the head coach of the Italian national football team following the resignation of the previous leadership. His appointment follows the withdrawal of Andrea Pirlo from consideration due to a controversy involving his ties to a betting company. Additionally, Claudio Ranieri has been named the new technical director to replace Paolo Maldini, who stepped down amid the organizational turmoil.
amharic: ሮቤርቶ ማንቺኒ የቀድሞው የአመራር አካል መልቀቁን ተከትሎ የጣሊያን ብሄራዊ እግር ኳስ ቡድን ዋና አሰልጣኝ ሆነው ተመልሰዋል። ይህ ሹመት የተሰጠው አንድሪያ ፒርሎ ከውርርድ ኩባንያ ጋር ባላቸው ግንኙነት በተፈጠረ ውዝግብ ምክንያት ከውድድሩ ራሳቸውን ካገለሉ በኋላ ነው። በተጨማሪም ከስልጣን በለቀቁት ፓኦሎ ማልዲኒ ምትክ ክላውዲዮ ራኒየሪ አዲሱ የቴክኒክ ዳይሬክተር ሆነው ተሾመዋል።
oromo: Roberto Mancini hogganoota duraanii hojii gad-lakkisuu isaanii hordofee leenjisaa garee kubbaa miilaa biyyoolessaa Xaaliyaanii ta'ee deebi'eera. Muudamni isaa kan ta'e, Andrea Pirlo walitti dhufeenya inni dhaabbata bettii wajjin qabu irratti falmii uumameen booda of duuba erga jedhee booda. Kana malees, Claudio Ranieri bakka Paolo Maldini kan hojii gad-lakkisee dirqama daayireektara teeknikaa haaraa ta'ee fudhateera.

title: Iraqi PM visits Turkiye to boost ties despite complex challenges
english: Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi is leading a high-level delegation to Turkiye to strengthen bilateral ties and address critical issues including security, water resources, and economic cooperation. A primary goal of the visit is to negotiate a new oil export agreement, as Iraq seeks alternative routes for its crude shipments amid ongoing regional instability. Both nations aim to enhance their strategic partnership despite complex technical and financial disagreements regarding pipeline terms.

title: France and Spain brace for heatwave that could worsen raging wildfires
english: France and Spain are facing a new intense heatwave that threatens to worsen ongoing, destructive wildfires in both nations. While some progress has been made in controlling the blazes, officials are concerned that temperatures reaching 40 degrees Celsius will trigger further fire outbreaks. Massive evacuations have taken place in both countries, with authorities implementing strict bans on public events to ensure safety during this climate crisis.

title: Roberto Mancini to be named Italy head coach for second time, source says
english: Roberto Mancini has been reappointed as the head coach of the Italian national football team, replacing Gennaro Gattuso following the team's failure to qualify for the World Cup. He will be joined by Claudio Ranieri, who takes over as the new technical director. This leadership change follows a series of unsuccessful attempts to secure other candidates for the national side.

title: Israeli soldier runs marathon around Gaza outpost
english: An Israeli soldier recorded himself completing a marathon near a military base in Gaza to signal a permanent military presence. This action highlights the ongoing conflict and stands in direct contrast to the struggles of Palestinians, whose daily lives are severely restricted by war and displacement. The footage has drawn attention to the starkly different experiences of those living under military occupation versus those enforcing it.

title: Tate brothers face at least two more weeks in US jail as bail bid reviewed
english: Influencers Andrew and Tristan Tate will remain in a Miami federal jail for at least another two weeks while they fight extradition to the UK. They are facing 59 serious criminal charges, including rape and sex trafficking. Their legal team is seeking bail, claiming the brothers face significant safety threats while in custody, despite the brothers' history of flaunting a luxurious lifestyle.

title: War on Iran: What is Tehran's 'shadow fleet' really and how does it work?
english: Following the collapse of peace negotiations and a new naval blockade, Iran continues to export oil using a 'shadow fleet' of aging tankers to bypass US sanctions. These ships avoid detection by disabling tracking devices, utilizing ship-to-ship transfers, and registering under flags of convenience to hide their true ownership. While the US attempts to isolate Iran economically, this clandestine network remains a vital source of revenue by moving oil to willing buyers despite global restrictions.

title: Iran threatens Hormuz ban on countries accepting frozen assets under Trump plan
english: Iran has threatened to block access to the Strait of Hormuz for any nation or business that accepts Iranian funds seized by the United States. This warning follows a proposal by President Donald Trump to use frozen Iranian assets to compensate for damages occurring in the shipping lane. Tehran has officially rejected the U.S. plan, labeling it an illegal and provocative measure.

title: Inside Turkey's plan for world's largest startup hub at Ataturk Airport
english: Turkish officials are transforming the decommissioned Ataturk Airport in Istanbul into 'Terminal Istanbul,' an expansive hub designed to be the world's largest center for startups and entrepreneurs. The project converts old terminal buildings into modern offices and incubation spaces to attract international investors and help local businesses reach global markets. Key partnerships, including with the global accelerator Techstars and Chinese investment funds, have already been established to support this innovative ecosystem.
